note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. Written by the team, voiced with ElevenLabs TTS. No real customer data.

key_signals: 情绪强烈但无未解决诉求
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 硬样本：客户全程情绪激动、反复打断、语速快、音量高，但客服在通话内就把问题彻底解决了，承诺当场兑现。如果系统把这一单判为高风险，说明它在做情绪分析而不是诉求追踪。这是证明我们区别于 Observe.AI 一类产品的关键负样本。

contacts.summary: Customer is very angry about a double charge. Agent identifies the duplicate, reverses it during the call, and gives a reference number.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: This is the second time this has happened and frankly I've had enough. You've charged me twice for the same month. Twice!

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry — let me pull the billing up right now.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don't want an apology, I want my money back. It's eighty-nine dollars that shouldn't have left my account.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You're right, I can see it. There are two charges of eighty-nine dollars on the third. I'm reversing the duplicate now while you're on the line.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Now? You can just do that now? Then why did it take an argument?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: It's done — reference 4471-B. The eighty-nine dollars goes back to the same card, and your bank usually shows it within three business days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Three days. Fine. And it won't happen again next month?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I've also removed the duplicate billing entry that caused it, so the charge can't repeat. You'll see one charge next month, not two.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Alright. Well. That's sorted then. Thank you.
